package.description: Re-typesets only the LaTeX paragraph you are editing in about a millisecond with an unmodified LuaTeX.
package.installationNotes: rtex needs a TeX Live installation that provides LuaLaTeX with a LaTeX kernel from 2021 or later; pdfLaTeX and XeLaTeX are not supported. Run `rtex doctor` to check that rtex finds its support files and your LuaLaTeX.

en-US.copyright: Copyright (c) 2026 Henry Yang and the realtime-tex contributors
en-US.description: Re-typesets only the LaTeX paragraph you are editing in about a millisecond with an unmodified LuaTeX.
en-US.installationNotes: rtex needs a TeX Live installation that provides LuaLaTeX with a LaTeX kernel from 2021 or later; pdfLaTeX and XeLaTeX are not supported. Run `rtex doctor` to check that rtex finds its support files and your LuaLaTeX.
en-US.longDescription: rtex is a typesetting engine for editors. When you type, it re-typesets only the paragraph being edited through a LuaLaTeX process that has already loaded your preamble, and hands the editor the new lines to draw. A full background compile takes care of what really is global: page breaks, floats, the table of contents, references and bibliographies. The result is exactly what LuaLaTeX produces — the same line breaks and the same glyphs at the same positions to 1/65536 pt — because rtex uses an unmodified LuaTeX from TeX Live and exported PDFs are identical to a normal LuaLaTeX build. Time from keystroke to updated paragraph is about a millisecond and does not depend on document length. The archive contains the `rtex` command, the C library and header, and rtex TeX support files.
en-US.name: realtime-tex
en-US.releaseNotes:
Thank you @ACG-j for the rtex serve timeout flags and the math ownership work!
Added
- Math source ownership (opt-in). Set math_owner_attribute and rtex reports which math source each glyph and math field comes from, in math_owners display-list metadata (binary record 0x29). Empty fields, including empty unicode-math radical degrees, get zero-size anchors. Off by default; PDF output is unchanged. (#30, #31, #32)
- rtex serve --compile-timeout-ms and --pass-timeout-ms set the live-compile and background-pass timeouts. Defaults are unchanged. (#36)
Fixed
- Build files no longer fill your disk. The build directory links to the project's files instead of copying the main file's folder three times; on Windows without Developer Mode it uses junctions and hard links. A snapshot from an earlier version is replaced on the first pass. (realtime-tex-vsc-plugin#13, realtime-tex-vsc-plugin#15)
- Title pages. Documents whose \maketitle makes its own page (report, book, article[titlepage]) no longer restart the engine about every 0.4 s. (#37)
- Faster first live update. set_document applies only the bytes that differ, so opening a file no longer counts as a preamble edit. On a 300-page book the first live update comes after 8.1 s instead of 24.2 s.
Faster
- Background passes on long documents: on a 300-page book a layout after a one-character edit takes 4.8 s instead of 7.6 s, and the first layout 10.1 s instead of 16.4 s. Per-keystroke bookkeeping is cheaper too, and Linux saves a thread wake-up per live update. (#38)

zh-CN.description: 用未经修改的 LuaTeX，在约一毫秒内只重新排版你正在编辑的那个 LaTeX 段落。
zh-CN.installationNotes: rtex 需要已安装提供 LuaLaTeX 的 TeX Live（LaTeX 内核 2021 或更新版本），不支持 pdfLaTeX 与 XeLaTeX。可运行 `rtex doctor` 检查 rtex 能否找到自身支持文件与 LuaLaTeX。
zh-CN.longDescription: rtex 是面向编辑器的排版引擎。你打字时，它只重新排版当前正在编辑的段落——使用一个已经加载好导言区的 LuaLaTeX 进程，并把新的行交给编辑器绘制。后台的完整编译负责真正全局的内容：分页、浮动体、目录、交叉引用和参考文献。结果与 LuaLaTeX 的输出完全一致——相同的断行与字形，位置精确到 1/65536 pt——因为 rtex 使用 TeX Live 中未经修改的 LuaTeX，导出的 PDF 与正常 LuaLaTeX 构建的 PDF 相同。从按键到段落更新的耗时约为 1 毫秒，且不随文档长度变化。压缩包内含 `rtex` 命令、C 库与头文件，以及 rtex 的 TeX 支持文件。
